mapper.select: SELECT winning_record_row.id AS winning_record_id, draw_record_row.user_id, draw_record_row.activity_id, winning_record_row.activity_prize_id, ( SELECT activity_prize_snapshot.prize_id FROM activity_prize AS activity_prize_snapshot WHERE activity_prize_snapshot.id = winning_record_row.activity_prize_id ) AS prize_id, ( SELECT activity_prize_snapshot.prize_type_snapshot FROM activity_prize AS activity_prize_snapshot WHERE activity_prize_snapshot.id = winning_record_row.activity_prize_id ) AS prize_type_snapshot, ( SELECT activity_prize_snapshot.prize_value_snapshot FROM activity_prize AS activity_prize_snapshot WHERE activity_prize_snapshot.id = winning_record_row.activity_prize_id ) AS prize_value_snapshot, draw_record_row.result_status FROM winning_record AS winning_record_row INNER JOIN draw_record AS draw_record_row ON draw_record_row.id = winning_record_row.draw_record_id WHERE winning_record_row.id = #{winningRecordId} FOR SHARE

SELECT winning_row.id AS winning_record_id, winning_row.draw_record_id, draw_row.activity_id, activity_row.name AS activity_name, winning_row.activity_prize_id, activity_prize_row.prize_id, prize_row.name AS prize_name, activity_prize_row.prize_type_snapshot AS prize_type, winning_row.win_time FROM winning_record winning_row INNER JOIN draw_record draw_row ON draw_row.id = winning_row.draw_record_id INNER JOIN activity activity_row ON activity_row.id = draw_row.activity_id INNER JOIN activity_prize activity_prize_row ON activity_prize_row.id = winning_row.activity_prize_id INNER JOIN prize prize_row ON prize_row.id = activity_prize_row.prize_id WHERE draw_row.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY winning_row.win_time DESC, winning_row.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM winning_record winning_row INNER JOIN draw_record draw_row ON draw_row.id = winning_row.draw_record_id WHERE draw_row.user_id = #{userId}
